_comment: Single policy file. Banned clinical words, crisis phrases, regional resources and the curated micro-actions all live here, so reviewers can audit them in one place.

resources.NL: In the Netherlands, call 113 or 0800-0113 (free), or chat at 113.nl. In an emergency, call 112.
resources.US: In the US, call or text 988. In an emergency, call 911.

safety_message: I'm really glad you told me. You are not alone, and you deserve support right now. Please contact someone now. {resources}

micro_actions.breathing: Try 4-7-8 breathing: in for 4, hold for 7, and out for 8, a few rounds.
micro_actions.walk: Take a short walk, even five minutes outside, and notice what is around you.
micro_actions.friend: Send a short message to a friend you like talking to.
micro_actions.screen_break: Take a 5-minute break from screens and let your eyes rest.
micro_actions.one_good_thing: Write down one thing that went well today, however small.
micro_actions.water: Drink a glass of water slowly and take a moment before the next thing.

privacy_summary: I keep only what you allow: the date, your mood, energy and stress scores, and with your consent, sleep hours and a short note. You are known by a pseudonym, never your name or email. I use this only to reflect on your week. Check-ins are deleted after 90 days, and you can export or delete everything anytime.
